name: Reliance Home Finance Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2008, Reliance Home Finance Ltd is in housing finance business[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is promoted by Reliance Capital Limited (RCL) which is a part of the ADAG (Anil Dhirubhai Ambani Group) and holds ** 47.91%** stake in the company. RHFL is registered as housing finance company with National Housing Bank without accepting public deposits and is engaged in mortgaged based lending operations

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -83.1% over past five years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -48.8%
